response.sql:
WITH status_totals AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval,
         SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
         SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT status_totals.*,
         AVG(gb_per_minute) OVER () AS average_rate
  FROM status_totals
)
SELECT healtheval,
       total_scancount,
       gb_per_minute,
       gb_per_minute - average_rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM with_average
WHERE gb_per_minute > average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no usable rate (because the summed span is zero or missing, or the numerator is missing) are excluded from the average, consistent with SQL AVG ignoring NULL values. A zero summed span produces a NULL rate.
